critique: The render preserves the key preset traits: black background, centered wide horizontal white-smoke band, soft diffuse texture, and visible temporal evolution from t1 to t4. It still fails the thumbnail match because the core plume is visibly constructed from repeated bright sprite lobes. Dark vertical pinches remain especially at center-left and throughout the brighter right half, making the smoke read as segmented beads instead of one continuously merged drifting stream.

suggestions.why: Increasing emission density supplies more overlapping sprites between the visible lobe boundaries, reducing the persistent dark vertical seams.
Larger particle coverage increases overlap across the horizontal band so individual sprite silhouettes blend into a more continuous smoke plume.
